craft-libs.why: craft-web-recovery: crash-recovery copies of unsaved documents in the browser (IndexedDB, one Web Lock per tab, counted only after commit), the unload guard and download helpers; shared by every app's web save fixes, not in storytold's craft-libs yet (storytold/craft-libs#124)

patches.why: 0.8.0's web build panics at startup: std::process::id() has no pid on wasm32 (storytold/deckcraft#959)
One shader module for every kernel: a single kernel a browser rejects takes the whole GPU compositor down (Safari), and Chrome's GPU watchdog loses the device (storytold/effectcraft#1590)
Safari's WebGPU refuses fxn_median_huang: its 2048-entry histogram is over WebKit's 8192-byte limit on a function's variables

The web build never autosaved: no recovery storage, and its autosave timer never fired (now_ms() is 0 on wasm), so a reload or crashed tab lost unsaved documents (storytold/photocraft#6615). Uses craft-web-recovery from the craft-libs override.
